2. "O Parlamento deve apoiar o fortalecimento da Agência Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD), inclusive por meio de concurso público e investimentos, para aprimorar a proteção de dados pessoais dos cidadãos?" (Should Parliament support strengthening of ANPD, including via public competition and investments, to improve personal data protection?)

These are different topics: blockchain adoption vs strengthening data protection agency. They are different issues. So relation = DIFFERENT.

Reasoning: they address distinct policy measures (blockchain adoption vs ANPD strengthening). Answer one does not determine the other.
